feedback.overview: {"summary":"You demonstrated good empathy and ensured strong alignment with the prospect’s concerns about brand protection and ROI, maintaining control over the conversation and addressing objections clearly. However, your explanations sometimes lacked clarity and concrete details, leading to missed chances to proactively confirm understanding and advance commitment. Deal progression was steady but slow, with opportunities to create more urgency and stronger calls to action.","suggestedNextSteps":["Clarify numerical details proactively to avoid vague or confusing cost explanations.","Use concise summaries to confirm prospect understanding before moving forward.","Deliver stronger, clear calls to action to advance deal stages with urgency."]}

feedback.salesTechniques: {"description":"Measures the ability to apply MEX MEDDPICC methodology for budget constraint handling and campaign qualification.","overallScore":54,"maxScore":100,"sections":[{"title":"Metrics","score":7,"maxScore":13,"why":"You acknowledged the importance of ROI projections and incremental orders but did not explicitly quantify potential sales lift or reference MEX-specific ROI benchmarks or clear KPIs during discovery.","suggestion":"Incorporate sharing MEX ROI benchmarks (e.g., 8.5% outperformance, 20% incremental sales) and directly ask Rachel about the KPIs she uses to measure success. Example: 'Typically, our partners see a 20% lift in orders with campaigns like this. What specific sales or retention metrics are most critical for your branches?'"},{"title":"Economic Buyer","score":6,"maxScore":13,"why":"You did not explicitly identify or discuss who holds final budget authority or what information they require to approve campaign investment.","suggestion":"Directly ask who controls the marketing or campaign budget and what would convince them to approve. For example, 'Who in your organization would sign off on this spend, and what ROI data or assurances can I provide to help them feel confident?'"},{"title":"Decision Criteria","score":7,"maxScore":13,"why":"You addressed Rachel’s concern about brand protection but did not fully explore all evaluation factors, priorities, or must-haves beyond food quality and upfront cost clarity.","suggestion":"Probe what specific criteria beyond brand safety and cost matter most. E.g., 'Besides protecting your brand, what other factors will influence your decision—speed of results, customer retention, or campaign flexibility?'"},{"title":"Decision Process","score":5,"maxScore":13,"why":"You lightly touched on timing and follow-up but didn’t map the approval workflow or decision timeline including other stakeholders or deadlines.","suggestion":"Map the full approval process by asking, 'Can you walk me through the steps and who else needs to be involved before final approval? What timeline are you working with?'"},{"title":"Paper Process","score":4,"maxScore":12,"why":"You did not inquire about procurement, contract, or compliance requirements, nor offer to provide contract templates or clarify onboarding steps.","suggestion":"Ask about vendor onboarding and contract needs, e.g., 'Are there specific procurement or legal requirements we should prepare for? I can send over contract templates to help ease that process.'"},{"title":"Identify Pain","score":9,"maxScore":12,"why":"You acknowledged Rachel’s concerns about brand and budget pressures empathetically and responded with explanations about quality control and rapid issue resolution, but deeper probing on budget fears was limited.","suggestion":"Use LAER more explicitly by asking, 'Is the main challenge cash flow timing or uncertainty about the ROI you’ll get? We can structure a pilot campaign to reduce risk and ensure measurable returns.'"},{"title":"Champion","score":5,"maxScore":12,"why":"You built rapport and trust with Rachel but did not identify internal advocates or offer to arm them with ROI materials and case studies.","suggestion":"Identify internal champions by asking, 'Who else in your team would benefit from this campaign’s success? I can provide tailored ROI case studies to help them champion this internally.'"},{"title":"Competition","score":11,"maxScore":12,"why":"You positioned the campaign’s brand protection and responsiveness well, highlighting transparency and quick remediation, which distinguishes from competitors, but did not explicitly ask about alternatives Rachel is considering.","suggestion":"Ask about alternative options under consideration, e.g., 'Are there other marketing campaigns or channels you’re evaluating? I’d like to share how our approach differs, especially on ROI clarity and risk management.'"}]}
